definition.en: Mish Ana! is a secret-word party game for Android TV and Google TV: 3–12 players join from their phones by scanning a QR code, get a secret word, and find the player whose word is different.
definition.fr: Mish Ana! est un jeu d’ambiance du mot secret pour Android TV et Google TV : de 3 à 12 joueurs rejoignent la partie avec leur téléphone en scannant un QR code, reçoivent un mot secret et cherchent le joueur dont le mot est différent.
definition.ar: «مش أنا!» لعبة سهرات بالكلمة السرّية على Android TV و Google TV: من 3 لـ12 لاعب بيفوتوا من تلفوناتن بمسح كود QR، كل واحد بتوصلو كلمة سرّية، والهدف تكشفوا اللاعب اللي كلمتو مختلفة.

facts: Name: Mish Ana! (Arabic: مش أنا!), Lebanese Arabic for "Not me!".
Genre: party game, social deduction, secret-word / impostor word game.
Platforms: Android TV and Google TV app (Google Play package app.mishana.tv), plus a browser version that runs on any laptop or smart-TV browser.
How it works: the TV shows a QR code; each player scans it and plays in their phone's web browser (iPhone or Android). Nothing to install on phones, no accounts, no controllers.
Players: 3 to 12, one phone each, in the same room.

Roles: Civilians share the same secret word; the Mole gets a slightly different word and is not told; the Blank (from 5 players) gets no word, bluffs, and if voted out gets one guess at the Civilians' word to win alone.
Round: everyone gives one spoken clue, then everyone votes on their phone; the TV reveals the role of the player voted out.
Languages: English, French and Arabic (full right-to-left), with Lebanese word packs; 560+ word pairs.
Price: free to play; no ads, no accounts. Optional in-app purchases may be added later.
Privacy: players only type a nickname; rooms are deleted automatically.
Requires: internet on the TV and on every phone.
Does not run as an app on Samsung (Tizen), LG (webOS), Fire TV or Apple TV; owners of those TVs can use the browser version on a laptop connected by HDMI.
